items.text: Give conditions a duration in rounds, counted at the start or end of a chosen creature's turn, with an optional save that ends them
Conditions with a duration count down every turn and are removed automatically when they run out
Turn reminders show which conditions ran out and which saves to roll, with Saved and Failed buttons
Fill in a condition duration from a spell, like Hold Person
Players can set durations on their own conditions in the player portal
Add the Bloodied condition automatically when a creature drops to half its hit points
Start a homebrew creature from scratch or from a bestiary monster
Report a bug with a screenshot from the new bug report form
Pick one condition at a time and choose its duration right away
Expired conditions show up in the combat log
Initiative ties are broken by the initiative modifier when a creature is added or rolled, and the order you set by hand is kept
Notifications stack instead of replacing each other
New cookie banner with a privacy settings link in the footer and on your profile
The error page explains what went wrong instead of always saying the page was not found
Popovers fit on small phone screens
Campaigns can have up to 15 members including the owner
Damage at 0 hit points added two failed death saves instead of one, or two on a critical hit
Monsters and lair actions made death saves; only players and NPCs do now
Instant death from massive damage was only detected with negative hit points turned on
Exhaustion was removed when a creature dropped to 0 hit points
An initiative of 0 was sorted below creatures that had not rolled yet
Turn shortcuts moved the turn while typing in a field
Attack rolls skipped the extra damage dice and a natural 1 still hit
Spells without a saving throw showed a Wisdom save
Changes made by the DM did not always reach the player portal
Players could lower their armor class below 0 from the player portal
Negative initiative modifiers on homebrew showed an extra plus sign
Searching lists failed when the text contained commas, brackets, quotes or backslashes
Campaign access was not updated right away after leaving, a role change, an ownership transfer or deleting the campaign
The contact form and live room codes are protected against spam and guessing
